''See also: [[Naru Cassias Arelius Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Naru]] Cassias Arelius family{{!}}Arelius is a prominent member of the ancient Arelius family{{!}}House Arelius, originally destined to serve as the family's Jai Patriarch{{!}}Patriarch. A former heir and recognized genius of his bloodline, he possessed impeccable conduct and exceptional skill in the [[sacred arts]] from a young age. Though he eventually relinquished his position to Eithan{{!}}Eithan Arelius, he remains a significant figure within the clan. Cassias is characterized by his disciplined and serious nature, often maintaining an immaculate appearance with a focus on organization and decorum. He is frequently seen wearing his [[Goldsign]], a silver bracer that he maintains with great care, and carries a thin saber. As a [[Truegold]], Cassias utilizes his bloodline abilities to provide enhanced perception and spiritual awareness. His role has often involved managing family affairs, protecting employees, and overseeing the welfare of displaced clan members during times of crisis. He has demonstrated significant capability in combat and reconnaissance, once performing the work of twenty scouts during a battle. Cassias is also married to Jing{{!}}Naru Jing, a notable figure within the [[Naru clan]]. Throughout his experiences, he has navigated complex political landscapes, including tensions with family elders and the challenges of supporting refugees during imperial instability.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Naru]] Cassias Arelius family{{!}}Arelius has gold hair that resembles fresh wheat. He wears a deep blue silk shirt and pants featuring silver thread stitching, along with a silver bracer on his right forearm. He also carries a thin, silver [[sword]] at his hip.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|A genius and the former heir of the [[Arelius family]], Cassias was born to be its Jai Patriarch{{!}}Patriarch. He follows [[Eithan]] and travels alongside [[Lindon]] and [[Yerin]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|As a [[sword]] artist, Cassias utilizes [[sword madra]] that causes his core to shine silver. His powers include bloodline abilities, an expanded spirit-sense{{!}}spiritual sense, and the capacity to empower spears with his [[madra]]. Additionally, he can use [[madra]] to power [[scripts]] and possesses a [[Thousand-Mile Cloud]].}}
